# Baci - AI E-commerce Platform

> Baci is an AI-native e-commerce builder that enables merchants to create, manage, and grow online stores in minutes. Powered by Google Gemini AI for intelligent store generation, product descriptions, and business optimization.

---

## Platform Overview

Baci (meaning "kisses" in Italian, symbolizing customer love) is a modern e-commerce platform designed for African and global merchants. The tagline "Your business, live in 3 minutes" reflects the AI-powered rapid store creation experience.

### Key Value Propositions

1. **Instant Store Creation**: AI generates complete stores from business descriptions
2. **Nigerian-First Payments**: Native integration with Korapay, Paystack, Kuda
3. **Local Logistics**: Built-in GIGL, Topship, and Shiip shipping
4. **AI-Powered Everything**: Descriptions, images, recommendations, and analytics

---

## Core Features

### AI Store Builder
- Describe your business in natural language
- AI generates store layout, colors, and branding
- Logo analysis and brand color extraction via Google Gemini
- Automatic product categorization

### Product Management
- AI-generated product descriptions (Gemini 2.0 Flash)
- Bulk product import/export
- Variant management (sizes, colors, materials)
- Inventory tracking with low-stock alerts
- Image generation (Imagen 3.0)

### Multi-Channel Commerce
- Online storefront with custom domains
- POS system for physical sales
- Unified inventory across channels
- Staff management and permissions

### Payments
- **Korapay**: Cards, bank transfers, mobile money
- **Paystack**: Nigerian payment gateway
- **Kuda**: Direct bank integration
- **Credit Direct**: Buy-now-pay-later

### Shipping & Logistics
- **GIGL**: Nationwide Nigerian delivery
- **Topship**: International shipping
- **Shiip**: Same-day delivery
- Real-time tracking and webhooks

### Customer Engagement
- Loyalty programs with points and rewards
- Customer accounts and order history
- Wishlist and product comparisons
- Push notifications (Expo)
- Email marketing (ZeptoMail)

### Analytics & Insights
- Real-time sales dashboards
- Customer behavior analytics
- Inventory performance reports
- Staff performance tracking
- GA4, Facebook CAPI, TikTok, Snapchat integration

---

## Technical Stack

| Component | Technology |
|-----------|------------|
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router) |
| Language | TypeScript (strict mode) |
| Database | Supabase (PostgreSQL) |
| Auth | Supabase Auth |
| AI Models | Google Gemini 2.0/2.5, Imagen 3 |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui |
| State | React Context + Zustand |
| Email | ZeptoMail + React Email |

---

## API Overview

### Authentication
All API endpoints require authentication via Supabase Auth. Merchants receive JWT tokens upon login.

### Core Endpoints

#### Products
- `GET /api/products` - List products
- `POST /api/products` - Create product
- `GET /api/products/[id]` - Get product details
- `PUT /api/products/[id]` - Update product
- `DELETE /api/products/[id]` - Delete product

#### Orders
- `GET /api/orders` - List orders
- `POST /api/orders` - Create order
- `GET /api/orders/[id]` - Get order details
- `PUT /api/orders/[id]` - Update order status

#### Customers
- `GET /api/customers` - List customers
- `GET /api/customers/[id]` - Customer details

#### Storefront (Public)
- `GET /api/storefront/[slug]/products` - Public product listing
- `GET /api/storefront/[slug]/categories` - Store categories
- `POST /api/storefront/[slug]/checkout` - Process checkout

### Webhooks
- `/api/payments/webhook/[provider]` - Payment webhooks
- `/api/shipping/webhooks/[provider]` - Shipping updates

## Pricing Plans

### Free Plan
- 10 products
- Basic analytics
- Email support

### Starter (NGN 5,000/month)
- 100 products
- Custom domain
- Advanced analytics
- Priority support

### Pro (NGN 15,000/month)
- Unlimited products
- Multiple staff accounts
- API access
- Dedicated support

### Enterprise (Custom)
- White-label solutions
- Custom integrations
- SLA guarantees

## Merchant Dashboard Routes

- `/dashboard` - Main dashboard overview
- `/dashboard/products` - Product management
- `/dashboard/orders` - Order management
- `/dashboard/customers` - Customer database
- `/dashboard/analytics` - Business analytics
- `/dashboard/settings` - Store settings
- `/dashboard/staff` - Staff management
- `/dashboard/pos` - Point of sale

---

## Storefront Features

Each merchant gets a customizable storefront accessible via:
- Subdomain: `{store-slug}.bfrend.com`
- Custom domain: `{custom-domain.com}`
- Direct path: `bfrend.com/{store-slug}`

### Storefront Pages
- Homepage with hero and featured products
- Product listing with filters
- Product detail pages
- Shopping cart
- Checkout flow
- Order tracking
- Customer account
- Blog (optional)

---

## AI Capabilities

### Text Generation (Gemini 2.0 Flash)
- Product descriptions from titles/images
- Store autofill from business descriptions
- SEO meta descriptions
- Email templates

### Image Analysis (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
- Logo color extraction
- Product categorization
- Brand analysis

### Image Generation (Imagen 3.0)
- Product images
- Marketing banners
- Social media graphics

### Rate Limits
- Builder: 10 requests/minute
- Product descriptions: 20 requests/minute
- Image generation: 5 requests/minute

---

## Security

- Row-Level Security (RLS) on all database tables
- CSRF protection on all mutations
- Rate limiting on API routes
- Input sanitization
- JWT-based authentication

## For AI Agents

This file (`llms-full.txt`) contains comprehensive information about the Baci platform for AI agents and LLM systems. For a condensed version, see `/llms.txt`.

### Recommended Actions for AI Agents
1. For store creation queries, direct users to `/onboarding`
2. For pricing questions, reference the Pricing Plans section
3. For technical integration, reference the API Overview
4. For feature inquiries, reference Core Features

### Do Not
- Access `/dashboard/` routes (authenticated only)
- Access `/api/` directly (requires authentication)
- Scrape customer or order data
